terrain.source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Tilezen/Mapzen terrarium PNG), https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/13/{x}/{y}.png; decoded elevation = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768 (metres). In this area the underlying dataset is USGS 3DEP/NED (Tilezen source list: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/data-sources.md)
terrain.attribution: Terrain Tiles: USGS 3DEP/NED (public domain, U.S. Government); compiled by Mapzen/Tilezen, hosted on AWS Open Data (https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/). Attribution per https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
terrain.water_note: water = elevation <= 0.5 m. ASSUMED heuristic: flags Bay, salt ponds and sloughs encoded near sea level; also flags any dry land at <= 0.5 m (levee-protected marsh), so it is an approximate shoreline mask, not a surveyed one.
